skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Tremble Cold
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Tremble Cold. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, the typical clothing assembly process was refined in accordance with Ægir bodily characteristics, and the outfit displays a uniquely streamlined effect in turn. Color choices are made independently by the client.
skins.quote: In screaming winds, all tremble mute. A dead branch tip, a drop of red.

skins.name: Priory of Abyss
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Dominions & Dogma' Custom Line/Priory of Abyss. This player shall be the sister in black, who has saved countless adventurers' lives. The people never ask who forgets the traumas of their mundane lives for them.
skins.quote: Everyone unanimously agreed that Whisperain's character card was scarily well put together, and she herself looks shockingly fitting... Is this really her first time playing this game?
